sloka: एवं ब्रुवाणं रामस्तु हनूमन्तं वरासनात् ।उत्थाय सस्वजे स्नेहाद्वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह ।। ७.४०.१९ ॥
transliteration: evaṁ bruvāṇaṁ rāmastu hanūmantaṁ varāsanāt ।utthāya sasvaje snehādvākyametaduvāca ha ।। 7.40.19 ॥

translations.english: Rama, having risen from his excellent seat, embraced Hanuman who was speaking thus, and out of affection, indeed spoke these words.
